# cloudsigma_acls (Data Source)

Reads the CloudSigma acls collection as dynamic JSON. The response includes pagination metadata; this data source does not manage account notification or sharing settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity for the requested account collection.
- `json` (String) The returned collection response as canonical JSON, including pagination metadata.
